claim: The evaluation corpus and baselines can fairly test the thesis.

commands.targeted_tests: uv run --frozen pytest -q tests/test_frozen_g4.py tests/test_g3_frozen_smoke.py tests/test_g4_evaluation_config.py tests/test_frozen_g4_authoring_matrix.py

criteria.criterion: Final corpus is whole-family split, pinned, sealed, and independently verifiable.
Two independent blind reviews cover every history and pair; difficult histories receive second review.
Near-duplicate candidates are adjudicated with a hashed artifact.
Evaluation policy and deterministic matcher are frozen without learned predictions.
criteria.deviation: G4 cost comparison remains explicitly deferred until a dated price table is frozen.

criteria.criterion: Ordinary/oracle projections and four baseline contracts pass model-free smoke.
Holdout access, projection allowlists, distribution summaries, and reproducibility evidence are recorded.
Targeted and full test suites pass.

deviations: The dated external price table is not frozen; the frozen policy defers G4 cost comparison and does not permit a cost-based pass.
The final commit hash is recorded at evidence creation; the evidence packet itself is part of the subsequent accepted commit.
